sourcePlan.task.inputForm: 完整文字任务 + 随题分析属性表（待编制）
sourcePlan.task.scenario: 两层1乘2跨，指定矩形截面柱局部轴转90度，其余不变，双向侧力；完整属性按公共契约随题给出。 X跨6m、Y两跨各5m、层高3.6m；只将Y=0m的两根柱线局部轴转90°，屋顶节点(6,10,7.2)m受X向20/Y向15kN。
sourcePlan.task.modelingFocus: 局部轴与强弱向刚度不能混淆
sourcePlan.task.expectedOutput: 受力角点X/Y位移、旋转柱与未转柱端力、各柱脚反力及局部轴记录。
sourcePlan.task.gradingFocus: 局部轴与强弱向刚度不能混淆；指定位置/分量对照数值真值，输出文字与结构化结果保持符号、单位和工况一致。
sourcePlan.task.prerequisite: 局部轴输入与适配需验证；完整题面、参数/单位契约与真值待验证
sourcePlan.model.topologyKey: 空间两层X一跨Y两跨矩形截面框架
sourcePlan.model.boundaryKey: 全部柱脚六自由度固定
sourcePlan.model.loadKey: 屋顶节点(6,10,7.2)m的X/Y两分量侧力
sourcePlan.model.propertyKey: 仅Y=0m两柱线局部轴转90度；其余不转；局部基准轴另表给定
sourcePlan.engine.analysisContract: 保留题定几何、材料截面、边界和荷载；采用一阶线弹性静力、自重关闭。按明示全局/局部轴、字段单位及工况/组合计算；不新增刚性楼板、未声明刚臂或规范默认组合；结果位置/分量与原题一致。
sourcePlan.engine.executionRequirement: 拟要求真实 OpenSees 求解，保存输入与原始结果的对应关系；解析式/独立矩阵解用于校核，不能替代规定引擎执行证据。
sourcePlan.engine.requiredEvidence: 拟保存（尚未生成）：OpenSees 版本、可运行模型/脚本、节点构件和荷载表、实际计算日志、原始结果与工况索引、平衡/独立解校核记录。
sourcePlan.engine.adapterGap: 局部轴 90° 旋转、主惯性矩及双向节点力的空间响应须验证。 当前无据认定接口不支持；需实际能力测试后确定，不将未验证能力记为模型失败。
sourcePlan.engine.truthPlan: 拟建立独立审定的 OpenSees 模型及同版本/同设置参考结果；独立局部-全局变换三维解；90°交换主惯性矩的等价性与空间平衡复核。 参考值尚未生成。 所有题定输出均须覆盖，校核实现不复用被测转换链路。

turns.instruction:
Required solver: OpenSees.
Build a two-story spatial steel frame with X span 6 m, two Y spans of 5 m and story heights 3.6 m. Fix all six bases in all six degrees of freedom. The complete appendix supplies Q355 steel (E=206000 MPa, nu=0.3, G=206000/2.6 MPa, density=7850 kg/m^3), solid rectangular columns C1=400x500 mm, X beams BX=300x600 mm and Y beams BY=250x500 mm. Rotate the local section axes by exactly 90 degrees only for the two column lines at Y=0, on both stories: c0-0-1, c1-0-1, c0-0-2 and c1-0-2. Every other column and every beam remains at roll 0. The single load case D contains only a roof-corner force at (6,10,7.2) m with Fx=20 kN and Fy=15 kN. Use OpenSees for first-order linear elastic Euler-Bernoulli static analysis, self weight off. Report ux/uy at that loaded corner, all six local end-force components at both ends of every rotated and unrotated column, all six reaction components at every base, and a member-by-member local-axis record.

Use all public appendices. Report the complete requested numerical table and the required summaries.

requiredOutputs.description: Report each member ID, ordered endpoints, reference vector, roll angle in degrees and final local x/y/z unit vectors in global XYZ.

authoringNotes: The source leaves material, rectangle dimensions and initial axis convention to the appendix. Freeze Q355 E=206000 MPa, nu=0.3, rho=7850 kg/m3; columns 400x500, X beams 300x600, Y beams 250x500 mm.

Exactly the four column segments on the two Y=0 lines are rolled 90 degrees; the other eight columns and fourteen beams remain unrolled. The source specifies only the roof corner lateral force, so no gravity load is added.
All twelve columns are selected for end-force outputs to cover both rotated and unrotated groups without an ambiguous representative subset.
